summary: Bupivacaine carries the strongest safety alert from the FDA, warning of heart harm, misuse, neurotoxicity (nerve or brain damage), and cardiac arrest (the heart suddenly stopping) during childbirth anesthesia [3][4]. Label warnings also advise checking breathing, heart signals, and alertness after an injection, while noting cases of methemoglobinemia, a blood condition that limits oxygen delivery [4]. Separately, a small computer model—not testing done in actual people—estimated low risk scores of 39 for the liver and 18 for the heart [M].
